review_description: I decided to go local as I had used Plum before for heater/aircon service and couldn’t be happier. Great customer service and advice from start to finish.Upgraded 12 year old solar for a 6.6k system and installed the battery about 2 months later, super happy with the install and service from Plum.Install team excellent, system is rock solid so far and is providing around  90-95% of power to home. Haven’t used peak grid  power since battery went live.

Plum have just finished installing our roof top solar.It was a great team of workers who took the time to explain the process as they worked. They answered all the questions we had simply so we could understand. They cleaned up as they went and left everything tidy. A very professional job.

Picked Plum electrical because I had them previously install my ducted reverse cycle aircon and they did an excellent job on that.From start to finish Plum electrical were great to deal with.From 1st contact to completion of work the process with them was smooth and trouble free. They dealt with all paperwork and rebates with no issues.I had an existing solar system (Fronius inverter and Q cell panels) and they were able to integrate into new system and battery(16kw sun grow battery with Aiko panels)Quality of workmanship 1sr rate and completed all works with minimum of fuss and to an exceptional standard. Now enjoying all the benefits of my new solar system and already starting to see a return on my investment.Would highly recommend them

Plum Electrical were outstanding with the whole process. The quote was quick and efficient and totally professional. The in person verbal quote was followed up with a written quote, once confirmation was made that they could supply and install the inverter. Inspection of the solar system prior to installation was conducted promptly and day of installation went as planned, ie the Installer notified his arrival time and he was punctual as advised. He was professional, polite and dressed in company clothing. Upon completion of installation he provided an overview of the newly installed inverter. We highly endorse and recommend this Company.

Expedient and professional. Took the time to engage us in the process. Pre-empted most concerns and explained completely. Minor fault during installation involving plastering inside the house that was fully disclosed and attended to reasonably promptly. Will recommend if asked. Otherwise

I could not recommend Plum Electrical highly enough, from start to finish the communication was open and I knew exactly what was happening. The installers were great guys, very professional and kept the place tidy and hazard free whilst the works were being done.Great experience all round. Thank you Plum Electrical!
I’m very glad I went with Plum. The level of customer service and quality of installation was outstanding! Highly recommended
The team from Plum solar were professional from start to finish. Very happy with everything.

Seamless process from start to finish. Sales was a breeze, Install crew were great and respectful of me, my family and our house. Aftersales has been great but not really needed as the system has been working great since install.
Great crew of guys they were efficient tidy. Nothing was too much trouble. Overall. Great service. Highly recommend them.
